title: Control surfaces: X-Touch and BCR2000
summary: Station works with the Behringer X-Touch and BCR2000 control surfaces, with ready-made presets and MIDI learn.
alternateQueries: How do I use my X-Touch?
Why is my X-Touch not connecting?
How do I MIDI learn a knob?

blocks.text: The status line reports the connection: "MIDI: connected to <device>" or "MIDI: no X-Touch or BCR2000 detected yet".

Presets include Behringer Studio (a studio-wide preset for the X-Touch, BCR2000, voice toggles and transport), BCR2000 Mix, BCR2000 Signal (Signal Lab and sound design knobs) and BCR2000 Voice (hands-free voice toggle and talkback controls). The X-Touch is set up for hands-on track mixing and transport control. The active preset is named in the status line.
Surface faders follow the mixer's bank: paging channels in the Layers panel pages the surface too.
A surface button toggles scrub mode; the header then shows a SCRUB indicator. Jog-wheel scrubbing is not fully wired up yet.
MIDI learn binds a control to a Signal Lab Fader or Button Control node. Mappings are stored in the project storage, not in a file on your computer.
